react_native_issues.issue: props.pointerEvents JSX prop is deprecated on react-native-web — use style={{ pointerEvents: '...' }} instead. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/explore.tsx:52 and /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/workout.tsx:38 (carried over from iteration_4, still unresolved).

action_items: (Optional cosmetic) Replace JSX prop `pointerEvents='box-none'` / `pointerEvents='none'` with `style={{ pointerEvents: 'box-none' | 'none' }}` in explore.tsx and workout.tsx to silence the RN-web deprecation warning.
(Expected, not a bug) Top up / rotate the Emergent LLM key budget to unlock real GPT-5.5 streaming answers in the Coach tab; the UI failure path is already implemented and verified.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is large (~1614 lines) and still contains legacy Apex AI auth/workout/coach-chat/Stripe routes that the anatomy app no longer uses. Recommend splitting /api/coach/ask + /api/anatomy/model into a dedicated anatomy_router module and removing dead code (auth, billing, plan, workouts, /coach/chat) to keep the surface small and reduce attack-surface/maintenance cost.

coachApi.ts URL: `${process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL || ''}/api/coach/ask` — if EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is ever empty at build time the fetch will hit a relative path. It is set correctly in /app/frontend/.env, so no current impact, but consider failing loudly when missing.

Coach UI relies on body.getReader() (web-only). On native (iOS/Android Expo Go) the fallback path reads the whole text once, which means no token-by-token streaming on device — only on web preview. Acceptable for MVP but worth noting in a future native build.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — every requested testID found and interactive; cross-flow muscle→coach verified; budget-exceeded path renders friendly error without crashing

seed_data_creation: None required (no auth; lessons + muscle data are static; bookmarks/recents use AsyncStorage).
